lore.description: With a large blade at the end of its trunk, this simple yet powerful creature is thought to have been designed to clear the thick brush of Floria.
appearance: Large, heavy quadruped on thick columnar legs
Blunt low-carried head with a wide gape of long teeth
Single long trunk arching over the back, ending in a blade as long as the body
lore.habits: It works the underforests beneath the World Tree canopies, where open ground is scarce and obstruction makes the going slow, felling standing growth in long low arcs of the blade. It sets its feet and reads the tremor in the ground before it swings. It feeds as it works, on the growth it opens and on what the opening turns up. The toxic fungal blooms of the understory do not take in its hide, and what the brush tears in that hide closes over again. It holds the lane it has cut, in a forest whose answer to cutting is growth, entanglement and regrowth rather than a fight, and it gapes its long teeth at whatever comes down that lane.
lore.biomeNiche: the dense underforests and marshy wetlands beneath the World Tree canopies

signatureAbility.name: Understory Reaping
signatureAbility.description: The Kosanos swings its trunk in a long low arc and opens a lane through everything standing in it.
